## Active

### D-032 — A meta/dbTest YAML filename names the handler that merges it

> _2026-08-23 · core/blong-server · active_

The last `-`-separated segment of the YAML filename maps to the handler method:
`commander-accessAuthorizationMerge.yaml` is merged by `access.authorization.merge`. Any realm's
`meta/dbTest/*.yaml` is auto-bound as `<realm>.dbTest.asset` — `meta` is a well-known
auto-discovered layer and nested `db`/`dbTest` folders are scanned as handler groups — and the
shared `srv.db` adapter's `processSeedAssets` merges the YAML by dispatching
`ctx.handle(params, {method})`.
